rules.title: BitLocker volume is locked
rules.probableCause: At least one BitLocker-protected volume is locked, so Windows and servicing data may be inaccessible.
rules.recommendation: Unlock the protected Windows volume with the 48-digit BitLocker Recovery Key, then rescan.

rules.title: No accessible Windows installation detected
rules.probableCause: Windows is not visible to WinPE. Possible causes include a missing storage driver, filesystem damage, an offline disk, or a missing Windows partition.
rules.recommendation: Check disk visibility and storage controller drivers before attempting any boot repair.

rules.title: EFI present but BCD is not readable
rules.probableCause: The Windows installation and EFI System Partition are present, but no readable BCD store was found.
rules.recommendation: Back up the existing EFI/BCD data and consider rebuilding the Windows boot files with BCDBoot.

rules.title: Pending servicing operation detected
rules.probableCause: Windows has an incomplete or pending servicing transaction. If the boot failure started during or immediately after an update, the pending transaction may be involved.
rules.recommendation: Correlate CBS/Panther logs and the most recent update before considering DISM /RevertPendingActions.

rules.title: Basic boot structures are visible
rules.probableCause: The Windows installation, EFI partition, and at least one readable BCD store are visible. A pure BCD-loss scenario is less likely.
rules.recommendation: Continue with servicing, filesystem, system-file, and recent-update diagnostics.
